newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European Commissioner in charge of humanitarian action Emma Bonino says Zaire rebel leader Laurent Desire Kabila turned eastern Zaire into a "slaughterhouse".
-- President Jacques Chirac calls for a new momentum in France in a personal column published by regional newspapers this morning.
-- Chairman of General Electric Capital Europe Christopher Mackenzie says is interested in opportunities in financial services in France.
-- French insurer AGF and Germany's Allianz to compete for GAN in privatisation.
-- U.S. Federal Reserve grants Banque Paribas "primary dealer" status on the U.S. bond market.
-- Family-owned supermarkets group Auchan allies with the Agnelli family to develop activities in Italy.

-- Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere to submit their final offers for defence electronics group Thomson-CSF today, Prime Minister Alain Juppe said government would make a decision by June 30. Socialist party reaffirms opposition to the privatisation of Thomson-CSF.
-- Government reshuffles managing board at Eramet New-Caledonian nickel mining group.
